depurant.translation:
n. 净化剂, 净化器
[医] 纯化的, 净化的, 纯化剂

depurate.definition:
a. Depurated; cleansed; freed from impurities.
v. t. To free from impurities, heterogeneous matter, or
   feculence; to purify; to cleanse.

depurating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Depurate
depurating.translation:
vt. 使净化；提纯
vi. 净化；清洁

depuration.definition:
n. The act or process of depurating or freeing from
   foreign or impure matter, as a liquid or wound.
depuration.translation:
n. 使无杂质, 提纯, 净化, 使提纯, 使净化
[医] 纯化[作用], 净化[作用]

depurative.definition:
a. Purifying the blood or the humors; depuratory.
n. A depurative remedy or agent; or a disease which is
   believed to be depurative.
depurative.translation:
a. 净化的
n. 净化剂

depurator.definition: n. One who, or that which, cleanses.
depurator.translation:
n. 净化剂, 净化器
[医] 纯化剂

depuratory.definition: a. Depurating; tending to depurate or cleanse; depurative.

depurination.translation: [化] 脱嘌呤; 脱嘌呤作用

deputable.definition: a. Fit to be deputed; suitable to act as a deputy.

deputation.definition: n. a group of representatives or delegates
deputation.translation:
n. 代理人的任命, 代表团
[法] 委派, 委任代理, 委任代表

deputations.definition:
plural of deputation
n. a group of representatives or delegates
deputations.translation:
(deputation 的复数) n. 代理人的任命, 代表团
[法] 委派, 委任代理, 委任代表

depute.translation:
vt. 指定代理人, 委以代理人, 委任
[法] 代表, 代理人

deputed.translation: v. 将（工作、职权等）交给某人( depute的过去式和过去分词 ); 给予（某人）代表行事或发言之权

deputes.definition:
v transfer power to someone
v appoint as a substitute
v give an assignment to (a person) to a post, or assign a task to (a person)
deputes.translation: v. 将（工作、职权等）交给某人( depute的第三人称单数 ); 给予（某人）代表行事或发言之权

deputies.translation: n. 副手( deputy的名词复数 ); 代理人; （某些国家的）议员; （美国协助地方治安官办案的）警官

deputing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Depute

deputy.definition:
n. someone authorized to exercise the powers of sheriff in emergencies
n. an assistant with power to act when his superior is absent
n. a member of the lower chamber of a legislative assembly (such as in France)
n. a person appointed to represent or act on behalf of others

deputy center.translation: [医] 代理中枢, 第二中枢

deputy judge.translation: [法] 助理法官, 代理推事, 助理审判员
